source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The reconstruction pass borrows core while checking InternetMessageHeaders for duplicates. Once that collection ends, headers.extend(core) consumes the finished map directly instead of cloning every key/value into another iterator. The review requests this change and the original and accepted source adopt it. This is an owned-value choice in this function, not a general rule against clones or a measured performance result.
title: Header reconstruction consumes its finished core map after duplicate lookup
